roleInfo.name: Player
roleInfo.description: Resist temptation… or watch others crack.

Default.inAMomentTell: ($1) — in a moment, tell me whether you want Ludio to teach your group how to play Willpower!
Default.whoNeedsTheTutorial: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.
Default.trickTakingWithA: Trick-taking with a twist. You score points by watching others cave to temptation first. Win cards strategically — but the moment YOU win enough tricks, you're out of the round.
Default.eachRoundYouRe: Each round you're dealt 12 cards (10 in a 6-player game). 5 vice suits — Sweets, Scroll, Splurge, Lounge, Sips — each numbered 1-12. Higher rank = more irresistible.
Default.goingClockwiseEachPlayer: Going clockwise, each player plays one card. You MUST follow the lead suit if you have one. The highest card in the lead suit wins the trick — unless someone plays trump.
Default.fromRound2On: From round 2 on, the dealer picks one vice as today's craving — the trump suit. Trump beats any non-trump card. The dealer rotates each round.
Default.hitYourTrickThreshold: Hit your trick threshold and your willpower BREAKS — you leave the round and score points equal to every other player's tricks so far. Thresholds: 4 (3p), 3 (4-5p), 2 (6p). Break early → fewer points. Outlast everyone → ZERO points.
Default.pickTodaySCraving: ($1), pick today's craving — your trump suit.
Default.pickedTheTrumpFor: ($1) picked the trump for this round.
Default.wouldYouLikeTo: Would you like to play another round?
